notes.title: 6.18Version update notice-Major Update
notes.content:
Hash Oasis Major Update, The suspension will be updated at 16:30-17:30 p.m. on June 18, and the updated content is as follows:

1.Room Customization

Experience new customizable models and features, making your virtual space more personalized and vivid to satisfy your exploration and building ideas.
Rich Model Library: Includes everything from basic structures to furniture, lighting, toys, and more.
High Customization: Easily adjust models by dragging, rotating, and scaling.

2.Treasure Mining events

Create your own room, which will automatically generate treasure chests, producing 30 minerals every 3 hours. You can also enter any other room to seize minerals. The minerals can be exchanged for rewards.

notes.title: Hash Oasis Update Maintenance completed!!
notes.content:
Dear user:
We are pleased to inform you that the Hash Oasis anomaly maintenance has now been successfully completed. We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the maintenance and thank you for your patience and understanding during this time.

Update content
1. Fixed a number of known abnormal problems and improved the stability and fluency of the application.
2. Optimized the server to improve the overall performance and response speed.
3. Fixed the bugs reported by some users, and made corresponding adjustments and improvements.

Special reminder
Please restart the application client after the update is complete to ensure that all fixes and optimizations take effect. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us, we will be happy to serve you.
Thank you again for your support and understanding of our application, wish you a happy day!

Hash Oasis operations team
June 4, 2024
